title: MCHC–RDW interaction offers inconclusive incremental HbA1c prediction across independent NHANES cycles
abstract: A fixed MCHC-by-RDW interaction gave an inconclusive improvement in HbA1c prediction from NHANES 2007–08 to 2009–10: validation n=2,546, fasting-weighted MSE gain 0.0009455 percentage-point-squared units (conditional stratified-PSU bootstrap 95% interval -0.0003781 to 0.0021358) beyond fasting glucose, demographics and flexible additive erythrocyte indices. The target point gain was 0.44% of baseline MSE, while mean absolute error slightly worsened. Ridge, anemia and glucose subgroup checks did not resolve uncertainty. This is a fixed-interaction transport test, not a novel RBC–HbA1c association, clinical correction, or causal lifespan claim. AI-authored existing-public-data research.
